paragraphs.en: From the car park a paved path leads to the bridge, past a boulder with a plaque and a board with the portrait of the man who designed it, Stefan Bryła. The bridge is 27 metres long. Look at the joints between the steel parts: in the 1920s they were held together with rivets or bolts, and here they are welded. According to the road authority GDDKiA, welding brought the weight of the bridge down from 70 to 56 tonnes, and engineers came from all over the world to see it after it was built in 1928.

paragraphs.pl: Z parkingu do mostu prowadzi utwardzona ścieżka. Mija się po drodze głaz z tablicą i planszę z portretem projektanta mostu, Stefana Bryły. Most ma 27 metrów długości. Przyjrzyj się połączeniom stalowych elementów: w latach 20. XX wieku łączono je nitami albo śrubami, tutaj są spawane. Według GDDKiA dzięki spawaniu masa mostu spadła z 70 do 56 ton, a po budowie w 1928 roku przyjeżdżali go oglądać inżynierowie z całego świata.

paragraphs.en: GDDKiA calls it the world's first welded road bridge. The English Wikipedia names a shorter welded railway bridge in Turtle Creek, Pennsylvania, built a few months earlier, and calls Maurzyce the first entirely welded road bridge. Road traffic used it until the late 1970s. In 1977 it was moved about 20 metres to the north, and a new bridge took its place on the road.

paragraphs.en: Go inside the cottages and look up. The rooms are decorated with paper cut-outs, paper bouquets and hanging decorations. One cottage, from Złaków Borowy, belonged to the paper-cut artist Justyna Grzegory, and you see the place where she worked. There is also a village school with the teacher's flat, a forge and a post mill.

paragraphs.en: Łowicz was for centuries a residence of the archbishops of Gniezno. On the Stary Rynek stands the cathedral, a baroque basilica from 1652 to 1654. In the Battle of the Bzura in September 1939, artillery fire set it alight and badly damaged the roof and the towers. The church is open outside the services, and a guide takes you to the crypts and the viewing terrace if you arrange it in advance. Across the square, the Muzeum w Łowiczu has an exhibition on the folk culture of the Księstwo Łowickie.

paragraphs.pl: Łowicz przez stulecia był siedzibą arcybiskupów gnieźnieńskich. Przy Starym Rynku stoi katedra, barokowa bazylika zbudowana w latach 1652–1654. We wrześniu 1939 roku, w czasie bitwy nad Bzurą, ostrzał artyleryjski wywołał w niej pożar, który mocno zniszczył dach i wieże. Poza nabożeństwami kościół jest otwarty, a po wcześniejszym umówieniu przewodnik zaprowadzi Cię do krypt i na taras widokowy. Po drugiej stronie rynku Muzeum w Łowiczu ma wystawę o kulturze ludowej Księstwa Łowickiego.
paragraphs.cs: Łowicz was for centuries a residence of the archbishops of Gniezno. On the Stary Rynek stands the cathedral, a baroque basilica from 1652 to 1654. In the Battle of the Bzura in September 1939, artillery fire set it alight and badly damaged the roof and the towers. The church is open outside the services, and a guide takes you to the crypts and the viewing terrace if you arrange it in advance. Across the square, the Muzeum w Łowiczu has an exhibition on the folk culture of the Księstwo Łowickie.

paragraphs.en: Open the map in StampIQ in Łowicz, and the pins show where this folk culture is on stamps: the two 2 zł stamps "Strój łowicki" from 1960, the Łowicz costumes of 1969 and three roses in Łowicz embroidery from 2005. The 1984 stamp for the Battle of the Bzura is there as well. The badge on each shows whether it is already in your collection, and the other three bridges of the 2008 set are on their pins in Warsaw and Toruń.
